department: Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
benefit: You get Rs 1,200 every month (raised from Rs 1,000 in August 2023). You also get a free saree at Pongal and Deepavali, and free rice at the Anganwadi centre.

other: You must be destitute (no one to support you).
Your fixed assets (house, land) must not be worth more than Rs 1,00,000.

documents: Smart ration card or any address proof
Any ID proof (voter ID, passport, PAN card or driving licence)
how_to_apply: Get copies of your papers. Go to the nearest Common Service Centre (CSC). Give your fingerprint there. Fill the form and upload your papers. Ask for a receipt. Applying is free.
